title: Week 8 Quiz — Rome and Han China

questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects the evidence and interpretation emphasized in Week 8?

shortResponse.prompt: Using at least two specific pieces of evidence, answer: How did large empires build durable institutions, and why did those institutions eventually weaken or change?
